name: plaud
description: Turn Plaud.ai voice recordings into text inside the repository you are working in. The Plaud connector finds a meeting by what was said in it, transcribes it and names the speakers it recognises; the skill files the transcript where the repository's own .plaud.json says, so the same plugin serves a knowledge base and a client project without knowing either.
